rows.en: Heeey, Michel-kun! Sorry to keep you waiting.

Come to think of it, you're never late
for anything, are you, Michel-kun?
I see. That's Michel-kun for you.

(We hit all kinds of shops.
I'm pretty worn out.)
Wanna stop somewhere for tea, Michel-kun?
Hey, Michel-kun... Are you listening?

(Hmm~ What's up with Michel-kun?
Looks like he's staring hard at something...)
Ah! Michel-kun!

(Geez, Michel-kun... He ditched me
to go hit on girls...)

(Sigh, Michel-kun's such a handful...
Oh well, I'll grab some tea by myself
and head home.)

(I came shopping at "199", but I finished
way sooner than I expected.)
rows.notes: Male. 199 in quotes as in earlier rows (c04137), although this Japanese line has none.

rows.en:
(Hmm~ Going straight home seems like
a waste... I know, maybe I'll invite Michel.)

Oh, Michel. If you're free,
wanna come to the Shibuya Area now?

\p?
Sorry, I've got a date lined up
after this today.
O-Oh, I see...
rows.notes: x15, the player, many scenes; as c03261.

rows.en:
With an older lady I chatted up
in the Shibuya Area a while back...
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. onee-sama = 'older lady', as c09805.

rows.en:
(The lady he was chatting up
the other day, huh...)

Sorry, but invite me again some other time.
See ya.

(Sigh, if it's a date, I guess it can't be
helped. Still, Michel's success rate at
picking up girls is seriously amazing...)

(I came shopping at "199", but I finished
way sooner than I expected.)

(Sigh, if it's a date, I guess it can't be

(Michel's supposed to help me study
today, but...)

Yo, \p.
Right on time.

Thanks for doing this today.
...And don't go off hitting on girls
like last time.

Don't go dragging up ancient history.
Forget the past, and let's focus
on studying today.

Yeah, yeah.
I'm in your hands, Michel-sensei.
Michel, got a sec? It's this part here...
Ah, this part. Here, you do it like this......
Uh-huh, uh-huh, I see...

(Michel's explanations are easy to follow,
and they're a huge help, but...)

(For a while now, his face has been
weirdly close...)
Are you even listening?
Oh, yeah...
So, since this part goes like this......

(Even if he's teaching me, I don't think
he needs to get this close...)
Michel, got a sec?

I feel like your face has been
awfully close for a while now...
Is it? Must be your imagination.
(No, it's definitely not my imagi......)
rows.notes: x2, both genders. Cut off mid-word, as the Japanese.

rows.en: Waaaaaaaaaaah~~!!

Don't 'What's wrong?' me!
You just blew in my ear out of nowhere!!

Sorry, sorry.
Your ears are just so adorable.

Wha...! Huh!?
Wh-What are you saying all of a sudden!?
Michel!

I'm kidding.
Man, you're really fun to tease.
C'mon, let's get studying.
Michel!

Don't get so mad.
You'll ruin that cute face of yours.

Ngh!
Geez, give me a break already......
Haha, okay, okay, my bad.
rows.notes: x3: Michel here (both genders); the male player to Hoshimura in frd_yui_005 (after teasing her); fits both.

rows.en:
Hm? What's with that face,
\p?
Well, we had a quiz today, right?
What, did you do that badly on it?

No, the opposite.
It was stuff you'd taught me before, Michel,
so I aced it. Even I was surprised.
rows.notes: Male. 'solved it so well I surprised myself'.

rows.en:
Well, isn't that great?
Then again, I'm the one who taught you,
so it's only natural.

(Even though he teased me the whole time
we studied, I understood it that well...)

(I guess that just shows how good
Michel is at teaching.)

(Somehow that doesn't quite sit right,
though...)

If you want me to tutor you again, just say so.
Next time I'll take you through it hands-on,
every step of the way.
rows.notes: x2, Michel, both genders. tetori ashitori, teasing undertone kept.

rows.en:
(Next time Michel tutors me, I'd better
watch out so I don't get teased...)
Well, we had a quiz today, right?

It was stuff you'd taught me before,
